title: Taekwondo gold medalist Yape is PH flag-bearer in Asiad closing ceremonies
summary: Taekwondo gold medalist Jeus Yape will carry the Philippine flag during the parade of athletes in Sunday's closing ceremony of the 20th Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan.
